name: Entity Usage Light
description: Adds a per-entity "Usage" tab that, on demand, lists the entities a given entity references; configurable per bundle. A lightweight alternative to Entity Usage.

suggests.drupal/entity_usage: Recommended for an advanced tracking of entity references throughout your site.

project_description:
Simple and lightweight module to display referenced entities. Works with all entity types. Does not persistently track usage but simply displays, on demand, the list of referenced entities in a new "Usage" tab.

This module adds a tab to each activated entity type's local tasks where users with the required permission can quickly see the list of all entities the current entity references.

Most common use case: enable the "Usage" tab on Node and select "Media" to get the list of all Media used by a node - including media in WYSIWYG text, entity_reference fields, paragraphs, etc.

Detection covers entity_reference / entity_reference_revisions fields, image/file fields, Paragraphs (and fields nested inside paragraphs), Layout Builder inline blocks, and embedded entities in text (CKEditor) fields.

How to install: composer require drupal/entity_usage_light, drush en entity_usage_light, then activate per entity type at Admin > Config > Content authoring > Entity Usage Light settings, and select detectable entity types on each bundle's edit form.

Similar modules: Entity Usage - recommended if you need a more advanced tool to track referenced-entity usage throughout your website.
